title: Complementary and Supplementary Angles
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating complementary angles (sum to 90°) and supplementary angles (sum to 180°) with visual arcs and real-time calculations.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Angles
learningObjectives: Distinguish complementary angles, which sum to 90 degrees, from supplementary angles, which sum to 180 degrees
Calculate the complement or supplement of a given angle and verify it against the real-time display
Interpret the visual arcs to explain why the two angle measures always sum to 90 or 180 degrees
Predict the second angle's measure before adjusting the first angle and check the prediction with the calculation shown
